remarks: Tucked away on a private in-town lane, this beautifully landscaped and fully renovated home blends timeless charm with today's modern amenities. A welcoming courtyard leads to a beautiful covered porch and sunlit interiors with hardwood floors throughout. The gourmet kitchen features marble countertops and new Thermador/Bosch appliances, flowing into a bright family room with French doors to a bluestone terrace and large, private and level backyard. Upstairs offers a new primary suite with a luxurious bath and walk-in closet, plus three additional bedrooms, two full baths, and laundry. Just minutes to Greenwich Ave, shops, dining, and train.
